Recurrence — same alert as this morning. rp2's node_exporter recovered in between but dropped again with the same "connection refused" signature.
Diagnosis: node_exporter process on rp2 is repeatedly crashing/stopping (host itself is fine). Root cause still unconfirmed. (confidence: moderate)
Fix: SSH to rp2, restart node_exporter, but this time also check dmesg/syslog for OOM-kills or SD-card I/O errors — two occurrences in 6h means restart-and-wait isn't enough anymore.
Pickup: handoff 7sKd2PqLx9Wm — a third recurrence should be treated as a standing fault.
